name: gizza-ai/csv-cleaner
summary: Clean a CSV: trim, dedupe, drop empty rows, fill cells, normalize delimiter

tool.description: Clean a CSV in one pass: trim leading/trailing whitespace from every cell, remove duplicate rows (first kept), drop fully-empty rows, optionally fill empty cells with a value, and normalize the delimiter and line endings. `header`=true keeps the first row and exempts it from dedup/drop/fill. Each cleaning step is an independent toggle. Delimiters accept a char or comma/tab/semicolon/pipe.

dedupe.description: Remove rows identical to an earlier row (first kept). Default true.

delimiter.description: Input field separator: a single char or 'comma'/'tab'/'semicolon'/'pipe'. Default ','.

drop_empty_rows.description: Drop rows whose every cell is empty or whitespace-only. Default true.

empty_cells.description: Empty cells: 'keep' leaves them, 'fill' replaces them with fill_value. Default 'keep'.

fill_value.description: Value written into empty cells when empty_cells='fill' (e.g. 'N/A' or '0'). Default empty.

header.description: Treat the first row as a header: keep it and exempt it from dedup, empty-row drop, and cell fill. Default true.

line_ending.description: Line ending for the output: 'lf' (\n) or 'crlf' (\r\n, Windows/Excel). Default 'lf'.

output_delimiter.description: Delimiter for the cleaned output. 'same' keeps the input delimiter. Default 'same'.

trim.description: Strip leading/trailing whitespace from every cell. Default true.
